conversations.title: Which single item in the pending queue has the highest business value to resolve now, and why?

query.description: You want to see the single highest business-value item in the pending maintenance queue, including details about the line, plant, risk, and recommended action. The business value is measured by the predicted net value in USD, and the query ranks all at-risk lines with recommendations to find the top one.
query.query:
WITH `ranked_items` AS (
  SELECT
    r.`line_id`,
    a.`plant_id`,
    a.`line_name`,
    a.`machine_type`,
    a.`criticality`,
    a.`risk_band`,
    a.`failure_risk_score`,
    a.`open_wo_count`,
    a.`part_local`,
    a.`candidate_part_id`,
    a.`part_lead_time_days`,
    r.`recommended_action`,
    r.`predicted_net_value_usd`,
    r.`predicted_downtime_cost_avoided_usd`,
    r.`predicted_downtime_cost_usd`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.`predicted_net_value_usd` DESC) AS `rank`
  FROM `dfurg_febar_catalog`.`volta_industrial`.`gold_maintenance_recommendations` r
  INNER JOIN `dfurg_febar_catalog`.`volta_industrial`.`gold_open_atrisk` a
    ON r.`line_id` = a.`line_id`
  WHERE r.`line_id` IS NOT NULL
    AND r.`recommended_action` IS NOT NULL
    AND r.`predicted_net_value_usd` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  `line_id`,
  `plant_id`,
  `line_name`,
  `machine_type`,
  `criticality`,
  `risk_band`,
  `failure_risk_score`,
  `open_wo_count`,
  `part_local`,
  `candidate_part_id`,
  `part_lead_time_days`,
  `recommended_action`,
  `predicted_net_value_usd`,
  `predicted_downtime_cost_avoided_usd`,
  `predicted_downtime_cost_usd`
FROM `ranked_items`
WHERE `rank` <= 1

conversations.title: Why is LINE-04 trending toward a stop, and what are the three maintenance options with their predicted costs and net values?

query.description: You want to see detailed status information for the line identified as LINE-0004, including its risk and operational metrics, along with the top three ranked maintenance options for that line, showing predicted downtime costs and net values for each option.
query.query:
WITH `target_line` AS (
  SELECT
    `line_id`,
    `line_name`,
    `plant_id`,
    `plant_name`,
    `machine_type`,
    `criticality`,
    `vibration_rms`,
    `temperature_c`,
    `utilization_pct`,
    `failure_risk_score`,
    `open_wo_count`,
    `has_open_corrective`,
    `downtime_exposure_usd`,
    `risk_band`,
    `part_local`,
    `candidate_part_id`,
    `part_lead_time_days`,
    `current_status`,
    `last_check_at`
  FROM `dfurg_febar_catalog`.`volta_industrial`.`gold_line_status`
  WHERE `line_id` ILIKE '%LINE-04%'
     OR `line_id` ILIKE '%LINE-0004%'
     OR `line_name` ILIKE '%LINE-04%'
),
`ranked_options` AS (
  SELECT
    `r`.`line_id`,
    `opt`.`rank` AS `option_rank`,
    `opt`.`recommended_action` AS `maintenance_option`,
    `opt`.`predicted_downtime_cost_usd` AS `predicted_downtime_cost_usd`,
    `opt`.`predicted_downtime_cost_avoided_usd` AS `predicted_downtime_cost_avoided_usd`,
    `opt`.`predicted_net_value_usd` AS `predicted_net_value_usd`
  FROM `dfurg_febar_catalog`.`volta_industrial`.`gold_maintenance_recommendations` `r`
  INNER JOIN `target_line` `t`
    ON `r`.`line_id` = `t`.`line_id`
  LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(
    FROM_JSON(
      `r`.`action_ranking`,
      'array<struct<rank:int,recommended_action:string,predicted_downtime_cost_usd:double,predicted_downtime_cost_avoided_usd:double,predicted_net_value_usd:double>>'
    )
  ) `e` AS `opt`
  WHERE `opt`.`rank` IS NOT NULL
    AND `opt`.`recommended_action` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  `t`.`line_id`,
  `t`.`line_name`,
  `t`.`plant_id`,
  `t`.`plant_name`,
  `t`.`machine_type`,
  `t`.`criticality`,
  `t`.`risk_band`,
  `t`.`failure_risk_score`,
  `t`.`vibration_rms`,
  `t`.`temperature_c`,
  `t`.`utilization_pct`,
  `t`.`open_wo_count`,
  `t`.`has_open_corrective`,
  `t`.`downtime_exposure_usd`,
  `t`.`part_local`,
  `t`.`candidate_part_id`,
  `t`.`part_lead_time_days`,
  `t`.`current_status`,
  `t`.`last_check_at`,
  `o`.`option_rank`,
  `o`.`maintenance_option`,
  `o`.`predicted_downtime_cost_usd`,
  `o`.`predicted_downtime_cost_avoided_usd`,
  `o`.`predicted_net_value_usd`
FROM `target_line` `t`
LEFT JOIN `ranked_options` `o`
  ON `t`.`line_id` = `o`.`line_id`
ORDER BY `o`.`option_rank` ASC
LIMIT 3
